# Plainline

> Plainline is an AI agency. It brings AI into how a company's team works, builds AI tools for businesses (websites and apps are coming next) and runs the operations behind a business: every customer answered, every follow-up done, from an AI front desk for one location to a back-office team that Plainline staffs and runs for a large company.

- AI integration: Plainline researches a company's industry, picks the AI model that fits its work and rules (Claude or another enterprise model), sets it up with the team's own tools, playbooks and skills, trains the staff and keeps it current.
- The Engine: Plainline's AI-run CRM (leads, research notes on every account, tasks, and every piece of work measured, with AI agents working beside the reps). It runs Plainline's own team; companies can get it on its own or as part of a plan where Plainline runs the work with them.
- What Plainline builds: custom AI tools for a business's staff (dashboards, intake helpers, review desks, assistants). Websites built in Plainline's Studio and custom apps are coming soon.
- Operations plans, from most to least run by Plainline:
  - Back Office (large companies): Plainline staffs and runs customer messages, scheduling, follow-up, record keeping and reporting. AI handles the volume and tells customers it is automated; Plainline's operators handle the judgment calls; the client's managers can see the work.
  - Operations (multi-location teams): one system across every location for intake, scheduling, follow-up and a weekly report, with a Plainline lead.
  - Front Office (growing teams): the front desk plus follow-up on inquiries and open quotes.
  - Front Desk (one location): an AI text assistant that answers customers by text and website chat, books open times and hands anything tricky to the owner. It tells customers it is an automated assistant.
- How it starts: a walkthrough of how the business runs today, then each plan is scoped, Plainline builds and tests everything, the client tries it, and Plainline runs it and tunes it monthly.
- Pricing: every engagement is quoted per company after a walkthrough and research on the business. Plainline doesn't publish prices.
- Based in the Kansas City metro. Run by Plainlineops LLC.
